units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:3:4">Y. Snh. VIII, 26ᵇ</cite> top <he>גָּנַב בפני עדים גַּ׳ וכ׳</he> if one carries an object off in the sight of witnesses, he is a thief (amenable to the law <cite ref="Exodus 21:37">Ex. XXI, 37</cite>), if in the owner’s presence, he is a robber.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 57a:13">B. Kam. 57ᵃ</cite> since he keeps himself hidden <he>ג׳ הוא</he> he is a thief (not a robber).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 57a:13">Ib.</cite>, a. fr. <he>טוען טענת ג׳</he> he pleads that a thief had stolen the object in his charge.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26b:18">Snh. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ ניסן וכ׳</he> a thief (a laborer or tenant who takes fruits) in Nisan or in Tishri is not a thief (to be considered unfit to testify in court); a. fr.—Pl. <he>גַּנָּבִים</he>, <he>גַּנָּבִין</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 7:8">Tosef. B. Kam. VII, 8</cite>; Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin, s. 13; a. fr.
